sets.name: Blood1997A
sets.atlas: 2 x 2, one 1997 picture frame per cell
sets.material: deferred decal, translucent: base colour = BC.rgb, opacity = BC.a, normal = N (OpenGL: flip green), roughness = ORM.G
sets.known_weaknesses: the outline is the 1997 picture enlarged (39 to 51 pixels across), smoothed and broken up by noise: no single thrown drop with a tail as a photograph would show; 512 px per cell, so the largest placements (3.4 m) show 0.8 cm texels; wet look is roughness and a thin normal relief only.
